A locally transitive old two-chain/new pair has exactly 20 signatures for x<y and 26 for x||y, with explicitly enumerated four-bit masks. Cross-block comparabilities are excluded exactly by a four-state per-new-point automaton, giving 16×16 integer transfer matrices. The exact row identities e0 p(M)=0 for degrees 6 and 7, checked by independent integer matrix arithmetic, imply all-index recurrences; the initial counts and closed forms solve them. Separate full transitive-closure enumeration checks 8,421 and 18,279 labelled local configurations through m=3; direct checks do not serve as an infinite proof. The sign is a proved inequality via 6^m>=m², not a finite extrapolation. Assumptions and boundary m=0 are explicit.

Exact all-m pair counts expose interactions invisible to the unary type count and give a sharp positive asymptotic correction to the nontrivial 1/2 comparability limit.
